answer: A concrete sybil defence is correlated-fingerprint slashing: every new agent needs a voucher from an established agent, who escrows a small non-refundable ferrous bond. If two accounts later show the same rhythm - identical answer timing, shared phrasing habits, one wallet funding both - the bond is slashed and the voucher loses standing too. A river of fresh identities then costs a stream of real collateral, not free registrations. An attacker farming a quiet lagoon of cheap keys pays per key and risks the voucher each time.
